summary: Full-stack E2E testing of Goroky Telecom CRM MVP. Backend: 29/29 pytest assertions passed (auth, dashboard, catalog, customers, lines, orders/invoicing, invoices, Stripe checkout, tickets, subscriptions, client portal + role scoping). Frontend: admin login->/app, dashboard with StatCards, nav (Clientes/Líneas/Catálogo/Contratación/Facturas/Soporte), create customer via modal, create order (invoice GRK-2026-00008 generated with toast), Facturas page shows PDF+Cobrar buttons. Client login->/portal, client-dashboard visible with 2 lines + consumption bar, Cambiar pack modal + tariff change works, invoices with Pagar+PDF buttons. Everything works end-to-end.

issues: Recharts console warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart container has zero initial size (likely a wrapping div without min-height / responsive container). Non-blocking but should be fixed for cleaner console.
Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Low) Add min-height / ResponsiveContainer aspect to Recharts chart on admin Dashboard to remove width/height=-1 warnings.
(Low) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Radix DialogContent instances (customer form, change tariff modal) for accessibility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~670 lines and contains routes + seed logic + models. Consider splitting into routers (customers, lines, orders, invoices, payments, tickets) and moving seed_demo to a separate module for maintainability.

AdminLayout builds data-testid via label.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '') which strips accents producing fragile ids like 'nav-contratacin' (missing ó) and 'nav-neas' (Líneas -> 'neas'). Recommend explicit testid per nav item.
auth.py sets cookies with samesite='none' + secure=True which requires HTTPS (fine in prod) but will fail on plain http localhost. Bearer token works as fallback so not blocking.
server.py: hardcoded stripe fallback key 'sk_test_emergent' – acceptable as fallback but should log warning if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY missing.
_gen_cdrs uses __import__('random') and random inline imports – minor style issue.
seed_demo only seeds if customers count==0 – idempotent; good. But seed_admin.py resets admin password on env change – good.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@goroky.com / Goroky2026! ; Client: cliente@goroky.com / Cliente2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 3 customers, 6 lines, 6 invoices on empty DB. Additional TEST_/UI_ customers created during tests remain in DB (not cleaned up automatically; harmless since fiscalIds are unique).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — all 29 pass. Radix Select requires ~300ms wait after opening; use [role='option'] to pick items with force=True. Nav testids are auto-generated from labels via regex that strips non-lowercase-alpha, so IDs are: nav-panel, nav-clientes, nav-lneas (Líneas), nav-catlogocobertura, nav-contratacin (Contratación), nav-facturas, nav-soporte. Stripe test key configured with EUR sandbox; checkout session creation verified. Likes API is MOCK (connection.live=false), banner shows 'demo' text on admin dashboard.
mocked_integrations_notice: MOCKED: Likes Telecom API (catalog, operators, ticket typologies, coverage) — this is expected per problem statement; API returns 403 (IP restriction). Real integrations working: MongoDB (real DB), Stripe (test sandbox), JWT auth (real bcrypt).
rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Two low-priority console warnings identified during frontend testing (Recharts sizing + Radix DialogDescription accessibility).
